knows.statement: Greywatch has a dry locked maintenance stair through its cistern arch, usable without swimming.
Pike has tasked Mar, Toll and Arlo with recovering the fleeing Greywatch keeper; the keeper is seeking shelter and has not consented to their custody.
Avel and five armed followers have demanded surrender of Greywatch; Dera, Noll, Vela and Bess remain inside the shut tower. No breach outcome is yet resolved.
